name: JUDAO sell-hook pair-reserve desynchronization
summary: JUDAO's sell hook moved JUDAO out of its own PancakeSwap pair (daily mining and burn), synced the lowered balance as the reserve, and only then completed the seller-to-pair transfer. With a flash loan the attacker bought JUDAO, sold it into the pair to trigger the hook, and used the balance-over-reserve gap as swap input to withdraw excess USDT.
notes: Every sale calls IDOFundPool.fundUSDT, so the fund-pool pointer the owner set minutes after deployment is a module the exploit needed and is the reset (rule 10); startup() and the automatic launch flag are trading gates.

Loss is the pair's net USDT depletion, including fee-processing outflows to protocol recipients; JUDAO moved out of the pair is not valued separately. A scan of all pair USDT flows for same-tx buy-and-drain found no other exploit.
